# Events

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-events-doc.mjs from src/model/event-catalogue.js. Do not edit. -->

Listen with `gantt.on(name, handler)`, or on the host element for the bubbling DOM
mirror `gantt:<name>` (the same event object is the `detail`). Cancelable `before-*` events
accept `preventDefault()` and `waitUntil(promise)`; see [integration.md](integration.md).

## pointer

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task-click` |  | `taskId`, `task`, `originalEvent` | A bar, milestone or task row was clicked. |
| `task-dblclick` |  | `taskId`, `task`, `originalEvent` | A bar was double-clicked (opens the editor unless prevented). |
| `task-contextmenu` |  | `taskId`, `task`, `originalEvent` | Context menu requested on a task (right-click, long-press, Shift+F10). |
| `milestone-click` |  | `taskId`, `task`, `originalEvent` | A milestone was clicked. task-click fires too. |
| `link-click` |  | `linkId`, `link`, `originalEvent` | A dependency arrow was clicked. |
| `link-dblclick` |  | `linkId`, `link`, `originalEvent` | A dependency arrow was double-clicked. |
| `row-click` |  | `taskId`, `column`, `originalEvent` | A grid row was clicked. |
| `cell-click` |  | `date`, `rowTaskId`, `originalEvent` | Empty timeline space was clicked; carries the date and the row's task. |
| `delay-click` |  | `delayId`, `delay`, `originalEvent` | A delay band was clicked. |
| `task-hover-start` |  | `taskId`, `task` | The pointer entered a bar. |
| `task-hover-end` |  | `taskId`, `task` | The pointer left a bar. |

## selection

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selection-change` |  | `selected`, `added`, `removed` | The selected task ids changed. |

## drag

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `drag-start` |  | `kind`, `taskId`, `from`, `to`, `pointerType` | A drag began (move, resize-start, resize-end, progress or link) after the movement threshold. |
| `drag-move` |  | `kind`, `taskId`, `from`, `to`, `preview`, `pointerType` | Live drag position, at most once per animation frame. `preview` holds the cascaded dates of every affected task. |
| `drag-end` |  | `kind`, `taskId`, `from`, `to`, `cancelled`, `pointerType` | The drag finished or was cancelled (Esc, pointercancel). |

## before

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `before-task-add` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `task`, `changes`, `cascade` | Cancelable. A task is about to be added. |
| `before-task-update` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `old`, `new`, `changes`, `changedFields`, `cascade` | Cancelable. A task is about to change; `cascade` lists the successors the scheduler will move. |
| `before-task-remove` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `task`, `cascade` | Cancelable. A task (and, with cascade, its children and links) is about to be removed. |
| `before-link-add` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `link`, `cascade` | Cancelable. A dependency is about to be added. |
| `before-link-update` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `old`, `new`, `changes`, `cascade` | Cancelable. A dependency is about to change. |
| `before-link-remove` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `link`, `cascade` | Cancelable. A dependency is about to be removed. |
| `before-delay-add` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `delay` | Cancelable. A delay event is about to be recorded. |
| `before-delay-update` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `old`, `new`, `changes` | Cancelable. A delay event is about to change. |
| `before-delay-remove` | yes | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `delay` | Cancelable. A delay event is about to be removed. |
| `before-editor-open` | yes | `taskId`, `task`, `mode` | Cancelable. The built-in editor is about to open; prevent it to show your own modal. |

## mutation

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task-add` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `task` | A task was added. |
| `task-update` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `old`, `new`, `changedFields` | A task changed. Scheduled successors carry cause "schedule". |
| `task-remove` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `task` | A task was removed. |
| `link-add` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `link` | A dependency was added. |
| `link-update` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `old`, `new`, `changedFields` | A dependency changed. |
| `link-remove` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `link` | A dependency was removed. |
| `delay-add` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `delay` | A delay event was recorded. |
| `delay-update` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `old`, `new`, `changedFields` | A delay event changed. |
| `delay-remove` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `id`, `delay` | A delay event was removed. |
| `project-update` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `key`, `old`, `new` | A programme-level property (data date, revision, baselines, markers…) changed. |

## fields

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field-change` |  | `taskId`, `field`, `old`, `new`, `cause`, `transactionId` | One custom field (or core task property) changed on one task. |
| `validation-error` |  | `taskId`, `field`, `value`, `message` | A value failed validation and the edit was blocked. |

## batch

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `changes`, `source` | Exactly one per committed transaction (a drag with its cascade, an editor save, batch(), undo, applyPatch). Save back on this. |
| `edit-rejected` |  | `transactionId`, `label`, `cause`, `reason`, `taskIds`, `linkIds`, `message`, `error` | An edit was vetoed, failed validation, timed out, or was refused (locked, cycle, read-only). Nothing was committed. |

## lifecycle

## editor

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `editor-open` |  | `taskId`, `mode` | The built-in editor opened. |
| `editor-save` |  | `taskId`, `values` | The built-in editor saved; `values` is the patch it sent. |

## mobile

| Event | Cancelable | Payload | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fullscreen-change` |  | `open`, `native`, `orientation` | The full-screen chart opened or closed (`streamlined-gantt/mobile`). `native` is true while the Fullscreen API is active; iPhones get a full-viewport overlay instead. |
| `layout-change` |  | `mode`, `previous`, `orientation`, `width` | The mobile presentation changed: `mode` is `"inline"` (the chart), `"preview"` (the phone summary that replaces it below the breakpoint) or `"fullscreen"`. |
